name: Amman
summary: Amman combines relative stability in the region, Jordanian hospitality and exceptional nearby heritage – from Petra to the Dead Sea – with a moderate cost of living and a growing tech ecosystem. The digital nomad community is still small and bureaucracy and the language barrier can be an initial challenge.
strengths: Low cost of livingJOD 664/month — 23% below the average of the 90 cities
considerations: Quality of life below average6.1/10 compared to an average of 6.9/10
